ODRCC: estimators for regression with an outcome-dependent right-censored covariate

ODRCC.Rd

The ODRCC package implements the estimators in the manuscript for a linear model \(Y = \beta_0 + \beta_1 (A - X) + \beta_Z' Z + \epsilon\) when the covariate \(X\) is right-censored by \(C\) and the censoring depends on the outcome (\(C\) is independent of \(X\) given \((Y, Z)\)):

  • estimate_beta_ipw: the IPW estimator;

  • estimate_beta_mle: the joint MLE;

  • estimate_beta_aipw: the unguarded AIPW estimator;

  • estimate_beta_aipw_lambda: the guarded AIPW estimator;

  • estimate_beta_cc and estimate_beta: the complete-case, oracle, and naive estimators, for comparison;

  • ess_weights: the effective sample size of the IPW weights, which guides the choice between the estimators;

  • data_aft: the data generator of the first simulation study.

Every estimator returns estimates of \(\theta = (\beta, \sigma)\) and sandwich standard errors.
